relationships.subject: BK-(1-9)
relationships.evidence_quote: BK-(1-7) and BK-(1-5) are produced in vivo from BK-(1-9).

relationships.subject: BK-(1-7)
relationships.evidence_quote: Both peptides induced NO production in all cell types tested.

relationships.subject: B2 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: However, unlike BK-(1-9), NO production elicited by BK-(1-7) or BK-(1-5) was not inhibited by B<sub>1</sub> or B<sub>2</sub> receptor antagonists.

key_findings: BK-(1-7) and BK-(1-5) induce NO production and vasorelaxation independent of B1/B2 receptors and have reduced nociceptive and no permeability effects vs BK-(1-9).
